justification: The six-city squared-path construction is a different valid witness from the reference instance. Endpoint degrees force edges 12,13,46,56; excluding proper subtours then forces 24,35. Thus T* is the unique zero-cost tour. T costs 1 and shares only 12 and 56 with T*, so reaching any cheaper tour requires four replacements. All weights are symmetric and nonnegative, and T is therefore a nonglobal 3-Opt local optimum.
